subject: Re: Decision criteria clarification - latency, cost, deployment & SLA (Finova)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>

Subject: Post-call recap + next steps (Finova)

Hi Jamie —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary of what I heard:
- Primary use case: real-time customer support routing + light summarization of conversations.
- Latency target: p95 under ~200ms for single-turn generation — goal for user-facing interactions.
- Cost sensitivity: want to keep unit costs competitive; ballpark target discussed was in the sub-$0.003 per 1k-token range (open to tradeoffs if latency/SLA needs it).
- Deployment preference: Dedicated (private) deployment preferred for data isolation, but hosted fallback is acceptable during pilot.
- SLA: team asked about 99.95% uptime target and escalation procedures.

Stakeholders you mentioned to loop in:
- Economic buyer: Alex Rivera (CFO) — total cost / ROI decision.
- Security owner: Maya Singh (Head of Security) — SOC2, data residency and audit questions.
- Procurement: Liam O'Connor — contract and PO process.

Proposed next steps:
1) I'll share detailed notes (attached) and a short FAQ on how Redwood supports latency/SLA and dedicated deployments.
2) Can we schedule a 45-minute follow-up with your security and procurement leads + our infra architect (Rishi)? Suggested windows: Tue/Wed next week; send times that work and I'll coordinate.
3) If helpful, we can provide a scoped throughput/price estimate for a 6-8 week pilot.

Attachments: 20260506-finova-postcall-notes.pdf (post-call notes)

Appreciate any corrections — if the decision criteria above are off, call them out and I'll update.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0197

From: Jamie Park <jamie.park@finova.com>

Date: 2026-05-07T09:24:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps (Finova)

Thanks Marissa — that summary is helpful. A few clarifications from our side so you can shape the pilot & estimate: 

Decision makers / process:
- Economic buyer is Alex Rivera (CFO). He will own final sign-off but wants a clearly defined ROI and total cost over a 12-month run-rate.
- Security owner is Maya Singh; she will run the questionnaire and will want evidence around SOC 2, KMS integrations, and network isolation.
- Procurement (Liam) will handle PO and standard T&Cs; procurement turn time is typically ~2 weeks once legal signs off.

Decision criteria (more precise):
- Latency: Hard requirement is p95 < 250ms for our primary flows; preferred is < 150-200ms. If you can show 95/99 percentiles and breakdown by sequence length that helps.
- Cost: Our target for the pilot is to keep incremental inference cost under $0.003 per 1k tokens (we can stretch if SLA/latency requires a higher tier, but we need clear tradeoffs).
- Deployment: Dedicated tenants (VPC) strongly preferred for PHI-like data handling; hosted sandbox for pilot is OK if we have contractual protections and allowed data scopes.
- SLA: Target 99.95% with defined RTO/RPO for incidents; will want escalation paths and credits.

I attached a short spreadsheet with who owns which decision and preferred timelines (Finova-decision-criteria.xlsx).

Next steps:
- Please share an architecture runbook and an initial pilot cost/throughput estimate.
- Can Rishi join a technical discussion next week to walk our infra/security team through the dedicated deployment architecture?

Thanks — I'll coordinate internally for availability but tentatively we can do Wed 5/13 or Thu 5/14 morning PT.

—Jamie
Jamie Park
Senior Product Manager, AI Platform | Finova
jamie.park@finova.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-05-08T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Decision criteria clarification - proposed follow-ups & materials

Great — thank you for the detailed clarifications, Jamie. Action items based on your notes below.

What we'll deliver by EOD Monday: 
- Pilot cost & throughput estimate (scoped for 8-week pilot) with clear latency cost tradeoffs (quantized vs higher-performance configs).
- Architecture runbook showing Dedicated (VPC) deployment, KMS integration options, and fallback hosted sandbox.
- SLA summary and draft contract language for 99.95% uptime + incident response and credit calculation (attached: Redwood-SLA-FAQ.pdf).

Proposed logistics:
- Technical deep dive with Rishi (infra architect) + your security on Wed 2026-05-13 at 10:00 AM PT — does that work for your team? If not, send a few windows and we'll adapt.
- Procurement / commercial sync: Marissa + Neha to coordinate with Liam and Alex once we have pilot estimate. Typically we can supply an initial SOW + pricing and accept PO; contract redline cycle is variable (~1-2 weeks).

Quick note on tradeoffs (so Alex has context):
- Lower-cost quantized model configs reduce per-token price but increase p95 by ~30-50ms on our tests; we'll include measured benchmarks for the sample prompt set you provide.
- Dedicated deployment adds fixed monthly infra cost but simplifies audit and data-control workflows — we'll show the delta in the estimate.

Attachments: Redwood-SLA-FAQ.pdf

If anything above should be re-prioritized for Alex or Maya, let me know and I'll surface it at the kickoff.

Best,
Marissa
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
